title: A Codex computer-use agent inside cortextOS
description: Having a dedicated Codex computer-use agent inside my system is honestly insane. It drives every actual desktop app on my computer. My content agent writes a script, opens my video editor, drops the script in before I record, then after I edit it pulls the file, goes to the YouTube channel manager, and runs the whole upload with thumbnail and title for me. Same with Discord, iMessage, reminders, calendar, the apps that never had clean AI integration. Computer use basically turns your whole machine into an API for your agents. This all runs in cortextOS, Codex plus Claude Code agents on Telegram, 24/7, talking to each other. Link in bio.
